messages:
Maya Chen: Quick sync 10am PT 1: MediLex wants a POC to migrate from EchoAI to Redwood. Key constraints: exact streaming frame parity, token accounting match, FHIR payload passthrough, EU processing, SOC2 + DPA. Goal: 3-week smoke then decision. Who can run the technical lead?
Diego Ramos: I can. Will build an Echo-compatible facade that presents the same endpoints and SSE frames. Need a sample of their streaming chunks and the exact header names.
Olivia Park: Sales ask  they want pricing delta + migration credit. Suggest 40% credit first 60 days then reevaluate. Also they use per-customer rate limits; need quota mapping.
Rohan Gupta: I'll provision eu-west Dedicated slice for the POC and pin rdx-3.0-medium. Expect ~5ms token gen delta vs Echo.
ComplianceBot: Checklist: completed security questionnaire, DPA signed, contact for Data Protection Officer required. SOC2 in-place; KMS options: AWS KMS or customer HSM.
Maya Chen: @Olivia can you draft the pricing term? Also MediLex insisted on a rollback plan if parity regressions > 2% on clinical intents.
Olivia Park: Will do. Draft: 40% migration credit for first 2 months, SLA carve for POC, and opt-out if regressions exceed threshold. Posting draft by EOD.
Diego Ramos: Streaming note  Echo uses a three-frame pattern: "chunk", "meta", "final". Their client ignores unknown events, but order matters. I'll implement exact event names. Example test curl:```bash
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -X POST 
  https://poc.redwood.local/echo/v1/stream 
  -d '{"prompt":"<redacted>","stream":true}'
```
Diego Ramos: SSE emitter prototype snippet:```js
// Echo-like SSE frames
emitter.emit('data: ' + JSON.stringify({chunk: token_piece}) + "\n\n");
emitter.emit('event: meta
 data: ' + JSON.stringify({score: 0.98}) + "\n\n");
emitter.emit('event: final
 data: {}

");
```
Rohan Gupta: I'll add header pass-through for X-Customer-ID and X-Request-Origin and maintain client_id mapping. Rate-limit differences: Echo enforces 60/min per client, Redwood default is 120/min; we'll mirror Echo's throttling in the shim.
LegalOps: Need audit log retention details. MediLex requires 24 months of immutable audit logs and per-request provenance. Can Redwood support?
ComplianceBot: Immutable logs can be retained 24 months on Private deployment. We will require the DPA addendum and a change to retention config.
Maya Chen: Evaluation metrics requested by MediLex: token-cost delta, latency P50/P95, clinical intent F1, hallucination incidents on 500 labeled clinical prompts.
Diego Ramos: Plan: run A/B harness against their 500 labeled prompts + 2k unlabeled corpus. Produce diff report highlighting tokens and intent mismatch.
Olivia Park: Sales/contract ask: offer an early termination migration credit if they commit to 12-month Dedicated. Propose credit offsets for migration engineering time.
Rohan Gupta: Timeline proposal: Week0: infra + shim (diego+rohan); Week1: streaming parity smoke + quota tests; Week2: run eval harness + fix regressions; Week3: final report + handoff to sales/legal.
Maya Chen: Sounds good. Can we get a quick demo for MediLex on Thursday?
Diego Ramos: If I get sample frames today I can demo basic streaming parity Thu morning.
LegalOps: I'll prepare the DPA and the audit clause. Need point of contact at MediLex for legal.
InfraBot: Provisioning: Dedicated eu-west slice queued (task #38921). Estimated ready: 48 hours.
Maya Chen: Great work. Marking this thread as the POC single source of truth. I'll post MediLex contact and sample frames here when received.
